The main level features a bright living room with recessed lighting and a private balcony, as well as an adjacent designer kitchen with quartz countertops, a breakfast bar, an under-mount sink, and stainless steel appliances, including a dishwasher and vented microwave. The 30-inch stove provides plenty of cooking space. A conveniently located half bathroom on the main level adds to the home's functionality. The upper level offers a king-size primary bedroom with two closets, a private balcony, and an en-suite full bathroom, along with a queen-size second bedroom featuring a double closet. A second full bathroom on this level provides added convenience for residents and guests. Hardwood floors run throughout the apartment, and the ceilings are nearly 9 feet high. Each room is equipped with its own PTAC heating and air conditioning unit, and the apartment also features a sprinkler system, video intercom, and an in-unit front-loading washer and dryer. The building is conveniently located between Brighton Beach and Manhattan Beach, with abundant shopping along Brighton Beach Avenue and in Sheepshead Bay. Nearby restaurants include 718 Bistro, Tone Cafe, Beyti Kebab, Skovorodka, and many others. Transportation is easily accessible via the B and Q trains at Brighton Beach and the Q train at Ocean Parkway. Furniture shown in the photos is not included in the sale. Cold water is included in the rent. Opportunities to rent a south-facing duplex condominium with private outdoor space and included parking are uncommon.
